items.title: Flatness and regularity of the quotient by a subfield-generated polynomial subalgebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a Noetherian local algebra over a field of positive characteristic which is geometrically regular, a polynomial subalgebra generated by a transcendence basis of a finitely generated subextension maps flatly to the algebra and the quotient is regular. The proof identifies the localised polynomial ring as geometrically regular with the expected differential behaviour, uses the characterisation of geometric regularity through the naive cotangent complex to get an isomorphism on the first homology, and then chases the resulting commutative square of differential and homology groups to transfer flatness and regularity to the situation at hand.
